row.body: The route on the map ends at a closed road. A keyring is tucked beneath the last stop, its tag stamped “return”; the return line has been crossed out.
row.title: The last stop crossed off the van route

sidecar.gloss: A delivery key remains with a route whose return was cancelled.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field van could change its route when access changed and leave the key with an old map; the crossed line need not be an order to abandon anyone.

row.body: a broken barrier board crushed the pipe wrench against the folded road map. clean undersides show both were there before the road was blocked.
row.title: missing count beside the pipe wrench

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
